$comment: Effects atlas inputs. Frame sources: `strip` (a row of equal frames), `grid` (frames in reading order from a sheet; `count` limits it), `files` (one file per frame, either a list or every PNG in `dir` in natural order), or `script`. `scale` is a nearest-neighbour scale, `anchor` is "center" (default) or "bottom" (ground-based effects: the point where they touch the ground). Frames are padded to a common size, then trimmed to their union bounds. See assets-src/effects-catalogue.md.

slash-crescent.desc: golden crescent slash arc sweeping round (Weapon Slash, Classic 1); smooth glow, best drawn additive

slash-crescent-back.desc: golden crescent arc sweeping the other way (Classic 2): pair with backslash

slash-sweep.desc: wide, faint golden sweep arc low to the ground (Classic 3)

slash-stab.desc: diagonal golden stab streak with sparks (Classic 4): thrusts and dash-strikes

slash-streak.desc: long straight diagonal golden slash streak (Classic 5): sweeps and cleaves

explosion-small.desc: 32 px pixel explosion: orange flash expanding into a red, dithered cloud that fades (LPC explosions bang2d-1)

explosion-small-alt.desc: lumpier small explosion that breaks into chunks (lumpybang2d-1)

explosion-big.desc: 64 px explosion: big orange ball breaking into red dither (nicebang2d-1 at 2x, nearest)

explosion-ring.desc: 64 px expanding ring/donut blast (donut2d-1 at 2x): shockwaves, level-up

explosion-plasma.desc: small explosion that turns blue-violet (bang2d-plasma-1): magic hits

explosion-fire.desc: 64 px fiery orange ring explosion with drifting embers, 23 frames (Source of Tales bomb)

smoke.desc: small dark smoke puff that disperses (smoke2d-1): dust puffs, scorch smoke

smoking-bits.desc: red-hot bits flying out and smoking (smokingbits-1): debris

sparkle.desc: red-orange star sparkles spreading and twinkling out (sparkles)

sparkle-blue.desc: blue star sparkles (sparkles-blue-1): gem arrival, level-up

spell-fireball.desc: 64x32 fireball flying right with a flame tail (StarsteelGaming); rotate to aim

spell-icespear.desc: long pale-blue ice spear flying right with frost flecks (StarsteelGaming)

spell-thundersphere.desc: small yellow-white electric sphere bursting with spikes (StarsteelGaming)

spell-burst.desc: thundersphere at 2x: a radial burst of yellow-white light (the `burst` move)

spell-firelion.desc: 128 px fire lion rising from the ground and roaring, then dying to embers (Extended LPC Magic Pack)

spell-icetacle.desc: ice crystals erupting from the ground, then shattering into a frozen lump (Magic Pack)

spell-tornado.desc: whirling pale tornado growing and dissipating (Magic Pack)

spell-iceshield.desc: hexagonal ice shield forming into a sphere, then breaking (Magic Pack)

spell-spikes.desc: small earth spikes punching up out of the ground (Magic Pack)

lightning-claw.desc: golden lightning claws striking down and splashing (Magic Pack): chain lightning impact

lightning.desc: tall white-blue lightning bolt, two flickering frames (Source of Tales); anchor is the strike point at the bottom

fire.desc: looping small flame, 3 frames (Source of Tales fire); anchor at its base

blood-blast.desc: 34 px blood blast that spreads and fades, 13 frames

glow-splat.desc: single-frame soft dark-red glow splat (32 px): flash under gibbing

glow-mist.desc: 64 px dithered red mist: lingers where a body gibbed

soul-wisp.desc: pale blue spectral flame rising, narrowing and fading over 8 frames (fire art recoloured); anchor at the bottom where it leaves the body
